A horizontally oriented rectangular prism-shaped 3D miniature diorama model floats above an endless sea of clouds, supported by glowing levitating stones and vine-entwined stone pillars. It fully reveals a cross-section of an intricate terraced farming system spiraling along the mountainside: layered crescent-shaped paddies follow the virtual mountain contours, their mirrored water surfaces reflecting the sky. Golden rice stalks and emerald-green tea plants line the paddy edges, while miniature farmers bend to transplant seedlings, with bamboo baskets resting on the ridges. The cross-section exposes subterranean irrigation channels and ecological compost layers. The perspective adopts a slightly elevated isometric aerial view, showcasing the terraces' graceful curves winding from the foothills to the summit. The lighting captures the misty glow of dawn, with Tyndall effects piercing through the clouds and gentle ripples shimmering on the water. Ultra-realistic textures highlight damp soil granules, dewdrops on rice leaves, and the crisp masonry of paddy ridges. The palette combines high-contrast hues of cyan-green, gold, and milky white, set against a backdrop of flowing cloud rivers, creating a suspended agrarian utopia that transcends reality.

Focus on a 3D miniature sandbox model suspended above a vast sea of clouds, recreating an aerial terraced ecosystem spiraling along the mountainside: the terraces are lifted by floating stone clusters, with curved ridges built according to the terrain, cascading layer by layer. Water flows down from the mountaintop through a series of channels, shimmering dynamically under sunlight. Tiny farmers walk, plant seedlings, and harvest in the fields, their movements driven by AI physics simulations, appearing natural and fluid. Morning mist drifts slowly between the terraces, while flocks of birds take flight from tea bushes. Clouds roll leisurely beneath the model. The overall style is surrealistic micro-landscaping, pursuing cinematic CG effects with high saturation and contrast tones, highlighting the harmonious rhythm between humans and nature. The camera eventually pulls back to reveal the grandeur of the sandbox quietly floating like an island between heaven and earth.
